method: Read all four original PDF pages and visually inspected Table 1, Figure 1, Scheme 1, Table 2, Scheme 2 and Scheme 3 at 300 dpi. Checked all six tight crops for complete rows, chemical structures, axes, labels, and captions. Cross-checked construct identities, exact reported formulas/masses/yields, diagnostic NMR correlations, cyclase comparisons, and the distinction between measured structures and the proposed pathway.

verified_claims.evidence: Printed title, DOI 10.1021/np060290i, four-page J. Nat. Prod. article and corresponding author Yi Tang match the Zotero record.
pYT319 oxyABC gives 2,3; pWJ35 oxyABCDJ gives 1; pWJ85 oxyABCD and pWJ98/pWJ77 with additional cyclase genes list products 2-5.

verified_claims.source_locator: PDF p.1 Figure 1 and adjacent text
verified_claims.evidence: The CH999/pWJ85 trace includes new labeled peaks 4 and 5; the pYT319 control mainly shows 2 and 3; the text reports LC/MS ion 366 for 4 not detected in control.

verified_claims.source_locator: PDF p.1 right column and p.4 compound description
verified_claims.evidence: WJ85 formula C19H13NO7; observed 390.0588 [M+Na]+ vs calculated 390.0568; approximate isolation yield about 9 mg/L.
H-12/H-14 meta-coupling J=2.2 Hz; HMBC and NOESY connect aromatic and pyrone portions; the authors assign C-11-C-16 first-ring condensation.
H-8 and H-6 show 1H-15N HMBC correlation to the unique nitrogen, supporting the fused nitrogen-containing structure.

verified_claims.source_locator: PDF p.3 text and p.4 description/Table 2
verified_claims.evidence: 5 has neutral formula C19H11NO8, an additional O vs 4, low-field carbonyl shifts 181.7 and 184.23, and reported isolation near 2 mg/L; it is relatively unstable in DMSO.
OxyK and MtmQ constructs did not yield the anticipated C-7-C-12 products in the reported amide-started system; OxyK with C-9-reduced substrate is explicitly called unpublished data.
Scheme 3 is labeled proposed; authors state the biochemical basis of regioselectivity is unclear and discuss starter-unit effects and oxy KS-CLF conformation as possibilities.

verified_claims.source_locator: PDF p.1-3 Table 1, Figure 1, Schemes 1-3, Table 2
verified_claims.evidence: All six original graphics and captions are embedded; Scheme 1 compares compounds and is not misrepresented as a new reaction experiment.

unresolved_source_issues: 论文未报告构建体产物的生物学重复数、统计检验或完整定量峰面积；约9 mg/L和2 mg/L为该实验条件下的分离量级，不是优化发酵指标。
OxyD具体以malonyl-CoA还是malonyl-ACP为底物、C-11-C-16环化的催化步骤及PKS上中间体加工顺序未在本文逐项直接测定。
OxyK与C-9还原底物的对照被作者注明为unpublished data；机制仍可能涉及起始基团电子效应、链构象或oxy KS-CLF特性。
Scheme 3含有作者提出的路径步骤，除已分离产物及结构外，其他中间体和反应顺序不应视为逐步实验证实。
